title: Terms of service
intro: These terms are the agreement between you and Barmajiyat Ltd, a company registered in England and Wales ("we"), for using a Mutaba3a hosted account: the web portal and the iPhone and Android apps when you are signed in.

sections.title: 1. The service
body: Mutaba3a helps you record what you earn, what you're owed, what you've been paid and what you spend, across your personal money and the businesses you run. A hosted account keeps those records on our servers, behind your sign-in, so every device you sign in on shows the same numbers.
We may improve, change or remove features. If a change takes away something you rely on, we'll tell you in advance.

sections.title: 2. Your account
body: You create your account yourself on the web portal, or we set it up for you; either way, you choose your password through a link we email you. Keep your password to yourself: you are responsible for what is done with your account. If you think someone else has used it, tell us straight away.
When you accept these terms for a business profile you own, you confirm that you may agree to them on that business's behalf. People you share a profile with accept these terms for themselves.

sections.title: 3. Fees
body: The price is the one in the offer we sent you, or the one shown when you subscribe. Prices exclude VAT, which we add where the law requires. You pay monthly or yearly in advance.
Fees you have already paid are not refunded, except where the law says they must be.

If a payment fails and stays unpaid after we have reminded you, your account becomes read-only: you can still see and download everything, but you can't add or change records until you pay. We never delete your records because a payment lapsed.

sections.title: 4. Your records are yours
body: You own everything you enter. We use it only to run the service for you, as our privacy policy describes, and we never sell it.
You can have a copy of your records at any time. Ask us, and we'll send them to you as a file, or download them yourself from Settings where the app offers it.

sections.title: 5. Closing your account
body: You can close your account yourself at any time with Close my account: in the web portal under You › Account, or in the iPhone and Android apps on the Account tab. You then have 30 days to change your mind and keep it. After that we delete your account, the profiles you own with every record in them, and the record that you accepted these terms. Profiles you share with others stay with them, and what you added stays without your name. A few things are kept after that, such as the invoices that tax law requires us to keep; our privacy policy lists them. Our backups clear 14 days after deletion.
Before you close it, download your records: once they are deleted, we can't get them back.

sections.title: 6. Using it fairly
body: Don't use Mutaba3a for anything illegal, try to reach anyone else's records, test or get around our security, overload the service, or upload anything harmful such as malware.
If you break these rules, we may suspend your account. We'll tell you first and give you a chance to fix it, unless we must act at once to protect the service or other people.

sections.title: 7. We are not your accountant
body: Mutaba3a records what you enter and adds it up. It is not accounting, tax or legal advice. It doesn't file tax returns or issue official e-invoices, and we don't claim it meets any tax authority's rules. Conversion rates are for reference only.
Check important figures yourself, or with your accountant, before you rely on them.

sections.title: 8. Availability
body: We work to keep Mutaba3a available and your records safe, and we back them up every day. We can't promise the service will never be interrupted, for example during maintenance or an outage at our hosting provider.

sections.title: 9. Liability
body: We are not liable for indirect or consequential losses, such as lost profit or lost business, or for losses caused by records you entered incorrectly.
Our total liability to you under these terms is limited to the fees you paid us in the 12 months before the claim.
Nothing in these terms limits liability that the law does not allow to be limited, such as for fraud, or for death or personal injury caused by negligence.

sections.title: 10. Changes to these terms
body: We may update these terms. When we do, we'll ask you to read and accept the new version, by email or the next time you open your account on the web. Every earlier version stays available at its own address, so you can always see what you agreed to.

sections.title: 11. Law and language
body: These terms are governed by the law of England and Wales, and the courts of England and Wales decide any dispute about them.
These terms are written in English and Arabic. If the two texts differ, the English text prevails.

sections.title: 12. Contact
body: Write to us at info@mtb3a.com. We reply within 2 working days.
